OpenAI’s Real-Time API is a game-changing advancement in AI interaction, enabling developers to build apps that respond instantly—literally in milliseconds—to user inputs. It drastically reduces the response latency of OpenAI’s GPT-4o model to as low as 100 milliseconds, unlocking a whole new world of AI-powered experiences that feel more human, responsive, and conversational in real time.
Whether you're building a live voice assistant, a responsive chatbot, or interactive multiplayer tools powered by AI, this API puts real in real-time AI.
bullets: 🚀 Insanely Fast: Ideal for voice assistants
chatbots

tools.name: VEED
tools.description: VEED is an online video editing platform that allows users to create, edit, and enhance videos with ease. It offers AI-powered tools, automatic subtitles, and a user-friendly interface, making it ideal for content creators, businesses, and educators.
bullets: AI-powered tools simplify video editing.
User-friendly interface for beginners.

tools.name: trivoh
tools.description: Trivoh is an AI-powered collaboration and productivity platform designed to streamline workflow and enhance connectivity, even in low-bandwidth areas. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for virtual meetings, real-time collaboration, task management, and document sharing, all while prioritizing accessibility and security.
bullets: Accessibility Focus: Real-time transcription and sign language interpretation are exceptional features for inclusivity.
Low Bandwidth Optimization: Addresses a critical need for remote teams and areas with poor internet connectivity.

tools.name: Adpex AI
tools.description: AdpexAI is a comprehensive, AI-powered platform designed to simplify and enhance the creation and editing of images and videos. It offers a suite of tools that leverage advanced AI models to perform tasks such as face swapping, style transformation, background removal, and more. Whether you're a content creator, marketer, developer, or enthusiast, AdpexAI provides an intuitive interface to bring your creative visions to life effortlessly.
bullets: Advanced AI Technology: Employs cutting-edge AI models for accurate and realistic results.
Creative Flexibility: Offers a wide range of tools to cater to diverse creative needs.

tools.name: FlexClip
tools.description: FlexClip is an AI-powered online video editing tool designed for creating professional-quality videos with ease. It offers a range of features including templates, text animations, stock media, and AI-driven editing tools to simplify video production.
bullets: AI-powered tools for easy video creation.
Extensive template and stock media library.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.description: Otter AI Meeting Assistant is an AI-powered tool that transcribes meetings, generates automated summaries, and assigns action items—all in real time. It eliminates the need for manual note-taking, allowing teams to focus on discussions while ensuring nothing is missed. With seamless integrations and automation, Otter keeps teams aligned and productive.
bullets: Accurate AI-Powered Summaries – Saves time by condensing meetings into key insights.
Automatic Action Item Assignment – Reduces manual work for meeting leaders.

tools.name: OpenAI GPT 4o mini TTS
tools.description:
GPT-4o-mini-tts is OpenAI's lightweight, high-speed text-to-speech (TTS) model designed for fast, real-time voice synthesis using the GPT-4o-mini architecture. It's built to deliver natural, expressive, and low-latency speech output—ideal for developers building interactive applications that require instant voice responses, such as AI assistants, voice agents, or educational tools.
Unlike larger TTS models, GPT-4o-mini-tts balances performance and efficiency, enabling responsive, engaging voice output even in environments with limited compute resources.
bullets: Super Low Latency: Ideal for interactive and real-time applications.
Natural Sounding Voices: Delivers clarity and expressiveness at a compact model size.

tools.name: Oyeeah
tools.description: Oyeeah is a versatile platform offering a comprehensive suite of AI tools designed to enhance productivity and drive innovation. It provides cutting-edge solutions for automation, data analysis, content creation, and more, all integrated into a single platform. Whether you're looking to automate tasks, analyze data, or create compelling content, Oyeeah offers the tools to streamline your workflow and achieve your goals efficiently.
bullets: Comprehensive Toolkit: A wide range of tools to meet diverse needs.
Time-Saving Features: Automates tasks and repurposes content efficiently.

tools.name: Aiva
tools.description: AIVA (Artificial Intelligence Virtual Artist) is a cutting-edge AI music generation assistant designed to help you create original music in a matter of seconds. Whether you're a beginner exploring the world of music composition or a professional looking to speed up your creative process, AIVA uses generative AI to assist you in crafting songs across more than 250 different styles.
bullets: Fast Song Creation: Generate complete tracks in a matter of seconds
providing quick inspiration and reducing the time spent on creative blocks.

tools.name: OpenAI TTS1-HD
tools.description:
TTS-1-HD is OpenAI’s high-definition, low-latency streaming voice model designed to bring human-like speech to real-time applications. Building on the capabilities of the original TTS-1 model, TTS-1-HD enables developers to generate speech as the words are being produced—perfect for voice assistants, interactive bots, or live narration tools.
It delivers smoother, faster, and more conversational speech experiences, making it an ideal choice for developers building next-gen voice-driven products.
bullets: Incredible Real-Time Voice Generation: Streams high-quality speech instantly as the text flows.
Optimized for Conversations: Feels like you're talking to a person

tools.name: Synthesys
tools.description: Synthesys AI Video is an advanced AI-powered video generation tool that allows users to create high-quality videos using AI-generated human-like avatars and voices. It simplifies video creation by enabling users to produce professional-grade content without requiring expensive equipment or professional editing skills.
bullets: Realistic AI avatars and voiceovers enhance video quality.
Quick and easy video creation without technical expertise.

tools.name: AutoShorts.ai
tools.description: AutoShorts.ai is an AI-powered faceless video generator designed for content creators on platforms like TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels. It automates the entire video production process, including scriptwriting, voiceovers, background images, subtitles, and even direct posting to social media. This makes it ideal for creators looking to run a faceless YouTube channel with minimal effort.
bullets: Fully automated faceless video creation.
AI-powered scriptwriting

tools.name: OpenAI TTS1
tools.description:
OpenAI's TTS-1 (Text-to-Speech) is a cutting-edge generative voice model that converts written text into natural-sounding speech with astonishing clarity, pacing, and emotional nuance. TTS-1 is designed to power real-time voice applications—like assistants, narrators, or conversational agents—with near-human vocal quality and minimal latency.
Available through OpenAI’s API, this model makes it easy for developers to give their applications a voice that actually sounds human—not robotic. With multiple voices, languages, and low-latency streaming, TTS-1 redefines the synthetic voice experience.
bullets: Incredibly Realistic Voices: No robotic monotone—just smooth
human-sounding speech.

tools.name: sanas
tools.description: Sanas.ai is a pioneering AI-powered platform that delivers crystal-clear communication through real-time speech-to-speech AI technology. Its core purpose is to break down communication barriers caused by accents and background noise, particularly in high-volume communication environments like call centers. Sanas offers real-time accent modulation while preserving unique voices and emotions, coupled with omni-directional noise cancellation and speech enhancement.
bullets: Bridges Communication Gaps: Directly addresses accent bias and communication friction in global interactions.
Focus on Inclusivity: Aims to empower human capabilities and bring people into the workforce rather than replace them

tools.name: Tactiq
tools.description: Tactiq AI Meeting Assistant is an advanced AI-powered tool designed to transcribe and summarize meetings in real time. It seamlessly integrates with platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, capturing spoken discussions and turning them into actionable insights. With its AI-driven summaries and key action point extraction, Tactiq ensures that teams can focus on conversations without worrying about note-taking.
bullets: Real-Time Transcription – Eliminates manual note-taking
increasing meeting efficiency.

tools.name: echo
tools.description: MeetEcho.io is the company behind the Janus WebRTC Server, an open-source, general-purpose WebRTC gateway. It provides the foundational technology for developers and businesses to build robust, scalable, and customizable real-time communication (RTC) applications. Unlike off-the-shelf video conferencing solutions, MeetEcho.io offers the infrastructure that powers a wide range of real-time communication needs over the web.
bullets: Highly Modular and Flexible: The plugin-based architecture allows for tailored solutions and easy integration.
Open Source Advantage: Provides full control

tools.name: Loom
tools.description: Loom AI Video Recorder is an intuitive AI-powered screen recording tool that enables users to capture, share, and collaborate through high-quality video messages. Designed for both professional and personal use, Loom makes it easy to create and distribute screen recordings with AI-enhanced features, streamlining communication across teams, customers, and stakeholders.
bullets: Super Easy to Use – Simple interface with one-click recording and instant sharing.
AI-Powered Enhancements – Automates video polishing

tools.name: OpenAI GPT 4o mini Transcribe
tools.description:
GPT-4o-mini-transcribe is a lightweight, high-speed speech-to-text model from OpenAI, built on the GPT-4o-mini architecture. It converts spoken language into text with exceptional speed and surprising accuracy for its size—making it ideal for real-time transcription in resource-constrained environments.
Whether you're building voice-enabled apps, smart assistants, meeting transcription tools, or captioning systems, GPT-4o-mini-transcribe offers responsive, multilingual transcription that balances cost, performance, and ease of integration.
bullets: Blazing Fast: Ideal for low-latency
real-time transcription tasks.

With just a few minutes, users can generate original tracks tailored to their mood, genre, and creative vision—all royalty-free for personal or commercial use.
bullets: Easy & Fast: Simple prompt-based workflows allow full song creation in minutes.
High Customizability: Adjust genre
